text:
Aria: FYI customer Y asked for an "e-discovery bundle" for EU tenants: they want an auditable export that bundles events, associated encrypted artifacts, key provenance, and a legal-escrow checklist. They also want SOC2 control mapping in the bundle. We need a PoC scope + owners.

Nikhil: Key asks to call out: tenant-segregated KEKs, HSM-backed KEK in EU, documented emergency-escrow with 2-person approval, and per-bundle signed manifests. Also need to show proof of non-repudiation for who exported.

Bea: Legal: bundle must include chain-of-custody (who requested, approver, timestamps), redaction decision log, and retention justification. For EU customers highlight lawful basis and data minimization.

Miguel: Engineering constraints: bundling raw model outputs for exports raises storage & crypto ops. Proposal: store payloads encrypted under tenant data keys; bundle contains NDJSON index + references to blobs + encrypted KEK-wrapping metadata. We can stream-assemble bundle async. Expected PoC effort ~3 sprint-weeks.

Riley: Ops: retrieval time target for PoC: baseline async export (SLA) <6 hours for up to 500GB; hot-search for 90d remains primary for quick lookups. Archive must support object-store immutability + signed manifests stored in index. We can attach short-lived SAS URLs for retrieval that require signed attestation.

Tess: CS: buyer requires SOC2 mapping in the PoC: show exactly which endpoints/events satisfy CC6, CC7 controls (or internal mapping). They want a small acceptance checklist they can hand to auditors.

Aria: PoC scope (draft):
- Export bundle format: NDJSON manifest + zipped encrypted blobs + signed manifest.json + signature.asc
- Include: events (auth, invocation meta, config changes), artifact blobs (encrypted responses), redaction-log, key-provenance.csv, SOC2-mapping.pdf
- Keystore plan: tenant KEK in their KMS; we wrap data keys with tenant KEK and store wrapped keys in manifest
- Escrow: dual-signer approval flow, audited; escrow keys stored in customer-approved escrow HSM only if they request
- Legal-hold: per-export snapshot tag that prevents deletion

Miguel: Sample manifest record (NDJSON) idea:
{"event_id":"evt_123", "ts":"2026-02-05T11:22:33Z", "type":"model_invocation", "blob_ref":"blob://archive/evt_123.enc", "hash":"sha256:abcd...", "keystore_wrap":"kms://eu/key/tenantA/wrappedKeyBlob"}

Nikhil: Security additions: require signed envelope with ops key + tenant signature (if tenant provided public key). KMS rotation policy: rotate KEK every 120d with 14d overlap. Escrow access requires two ops approvers + customer rep. Log approvals and include signed attestation in bundle.

Bea: Add redaction profiles: "strict" (PII removed), "pseudonymize" (replace with reversible token stored under tenant key), "none". Customer can select per-export. Log which profile used.

Riley: Implementation sketch for lifecycle + immutability:
index.shard.rollover -> snapshot -> put-object (WORM) with metadata {immutable: true, manifest_id: ...} 
TTL job checks legal_hold table before deletion.

Aria: Acceptance criteria for PoC (what procurement/CS will sign off on):
- Produce an export bundle for a sample tenant (<= 200GB) that includes manifest + encrypted blobs + signed attestation
- Demonstrate KEK wrapping & rotation proof (show wrapped key, rotation logs)
- Provide SOC2 control mapping doc and show sample exported events satisfying those controls
- Provide retrieval runbook with measured export time and steps for escrow access

Tess: Customer timeline: wants PoC demo in 4 weeks. They need owner names for each acceptance bullet and artifacts to hand auditors.

Miguel: Tentative owners: export assembly + manifest: Miguel; KMS/key flows: Nikhil + Miguel; legal/attestation + redaction policy: Bea; lifecycle/immutability + retrieval runbook: Riley; customer comms + acceptance checklist: Tess.

Aria: ops-bot created meeting Thu 09:30 "EU eDiscovery & Escrow PoC kickoff" (zoom link). Please add any blocker items here before Tue EOD.

ops-bot: @channel meeting created: Thu 09:30 - "EU eDiscovery & Escrow PoC kickoff"

Nikhil: Blocker flag: need HSM test instance in EU staging for KEK ops. I'll create ticket for infra.

Bea: I'll draft the minimal SOC2 mapping and the redaction legal guidance for EU. Will drop drafts in the doc thread by Wed.

Miguel: I'll start a lightweight RFC today with the NDJSON schema and bundle assembly flow. If no objections we'll slot this into next sprint.
